summary: AI BRAWL Phase F2 (engine passives/specials + Fighter Forge UI + persistence) end-to-end verification. Backend 6/6 pytest pass (test_backend.py + new test_forge.py). Frontend Playwright verified: (A) default regression VOLT vs TITAN — game-canvas renders, HUD shows VOLT/TITAN, J/K/L work, VOLT special L transitions READY→3.8s (5s CD as expected); (B) Forge full flow — /forge screen loads, generate btn disabled empty→enabled on input, forge-loading shown, forge-result-card renders with forge-card-name/desc/stats/passive/special/test/save all present, backend returns forged name BLOODVEIL / GRAILBOLT / LIFESTEAL (none of VOLT/TITAN/WRAITH); (C) SAVE persists — card appears in BOTH player-roster and ai-roster with FORGED tag, survives page reload (localStorage aibrawl.forge.roster.v1); (D) two-step delete — 1st click flips × to '?', 2nd click removes card immediately; auto-revert restores × after 2.5s; (E) generated fighter combat — GRAILBOLT vs TITAN launches, player-hud-name shows generated name, L activates special (READY→4.8s cooldown), player-hud-shield DOM node present for shield buff; (F) small-viewport gate under 760px shows data-testid=small-viewport; (G) pause on tab blur — after document.hidden=true + visibilitychange, HP fill remains 100% (no leak). Controls modal opens on select screen; FIGHT button correctly gated when either side unpicked.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid HTML: a <button class='brawl-card-delete-btn'> is rendered as a descendant of the outer <button class='brawl-card'>. React logs a hydration/nesting error in the console every render of a forged card. Functionally works (stopPropagation prevents double-fire) but violates HTML spec and pollutes console. Recommend refactor: make the outer card a <div role='button' tabindex='0'> or move the delete button outside the card and absolute-position it as a sibling.

action_items: Fix nested-button HTML in SelectScreen.GeneratedCard (delete <button> nested inside card <button>) — currently emits a React hydration/nesting warning on every mount of a forged card. Not a regression blocker but should be cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: SelectScreen.jsx line 189/200: nested <button> inside <button> — invalid HTML5 and produces persistent React console errors. See action_items.

Stun chain-lock guard (STUN_IMMUNITY_S=1.5) is engine-level logic in fighter.js — not empirically retested due to LLM stochasticity of forging TWO stun-special fighters within a reasonable retry budget. Code path exists as spec'd; recommend main-agent-side unit-level assertion if guaranteed coverage needed.

Mirror match with generated fighter (same id both sides) was not explicitly clicked through, but the SelectScreen exposes the same card id in both player-roster and ai-roster (confirmed) and the engine derives a per-side clone; no code path indicates it would fail. Low risk.

Pause-on-blur was verified only during the initial 'FIGHT!' banner window (still 100% HP both sides); the guard clearly did not desync but a longer in-fight blur test would strengthen the assertion. Acceptable given prior iterations covered this.
seed_data_creation: None (localStorage roster cleared at start of each test block; forged fighters BLOODVEIL/GRAILBOLT/LIFESTEAL persist per-run only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct roster localStorage key is 'aibrawl.forge.roster.v1' (NOT brawl.roster.v1). Use it to read/write forged fighter ids. Buff HUD testids (player-hud-shield/boost/stun and ai-hud-*) are conditionally rendered — presence in DOM implies buff is active; don't treat absence as failure. Forge is stochastic; retry generate up to 3× if you need a specific special-type. Small-viewport gate triggers at <760px and short-circuits before select-screen mounts. Stun chain-lock immunity guard was NOT empirically triggered this run (would require two forged fighters both with SpecialType.STUN — flaky to reproduce).
